AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: In my 3.5+ years as a developer, I have focused on building secure, scalable backend systems using ASP.NET Core and Clean Architecture. I have experience designing high-performance Web APIs, handling complex remittance service workflows, and integrating international card payment gateways alongside national platforms.

My skills include developing maintainable, production-ready solutions that handle real-world cross-border traffic at scale while adhering to modern software architecture, PCI-DSS security standards, and engineering best practices.
Some of the technologies that I have trained and worked on include (but are not limited to):
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: .NET Backend Developer
Description: Design and develop secure backend services and API infrastructure for fintech platforms serving global remittance providers, local merchants, and internal systems.
Integrate international payment gateways including MasterCard Payment Gateway Services (MPGS) and Visa CyberSource to process secure cross-border card payments and tokenization workflows.

Architect and optimize high-concurrency remittance backend service engines, facilitating seamless cross-border payout distribution, real-time FX currency conversions, and local bank/wallet settlements.

Experience.Jobs.Title: .NET Backend Developer
Description: Co-engineered backend APIs for the Oromia Civil Registration System (OCRA), serving 350+ regional offices.
Integrated external government and enterprise services, designing robust data synchronization protocols across distributed databases.
